alert.name: ECSServiceAlarm
alert.summary: CloudWatch alarm fired for ECS service checkout

logs: EVENT Killing Pod/checkout-d79bb5b85-5xkkh: Container checkout failed liveness probe, will be restarted
EVENT Killing Pod/checkout-d79bb5b85-c2ql8: Container checkout failed liveness probe, will be restarted
EVENT Unhealthy Pod/checkout-d79bb5b85-5xkkh: Liveness probe failed:
EVENT Unhealthy Pod/checkout-d79bb5b85-c2ql8: Liveness probe failed:
EVENT BackOff Pod/checkout-d79bb5b85-5xkkh: Back-off restarting failed container checkout in pod checkout-d79bb5b85-5xkkh_warden-pg(<UUID_1>)
EVENT BackOff Pod/checkout-d79bb5b85-c2ql8: Back-off restarting failed container checkout in pod checkout-d79bb5b85-c2ql8_warden-pg(<UUID_2>)

root_cause.hypothesis: Deploy of checkout at 13:42:45 (python:3.12-alpine → 3.12.7-alpine) triggered crashloop via liveness-probe failures during container startup, not OOM. Both pods restarted repeatedly (restart_count 12, crashloop 2/2, pods_ready 0) right after the deploy, then recovered and reported healthy heartbeats ~3-4 min later. With a 48 MiB memory limit, app/interpreter startup likely runs slow/near the edge, so liveness probe (short initialDelay/timeout) kills pods before they finish booting; app itself is fine once past the probe window.
evidence: Alarm timing lines up tight with deploy at 2026-09-24T13:42:45Z
BackOff/Unhealthy/Killing events target liveness probe failures, not OOM
Both pods eventually log 'started, healthy' + 'heartbeat ok' at 13:46, ~3-4 min post-deploy
restart_count 12 across 2 pods = repeated probe-kill cycles before stabilizing
ruled_out: OOM kill as direct cause — oom_killed_containers is 0
Bad image / app crash — containers do reach healthy state, so binary runs fine once up

proposal.reasoning: Deploy at 13:42:45 (python:3.12-alpine -> 3.12.7-alpine) time-correlates w/ crashloop start. Liveness probe kills both pods during slow startup under tight 48MiB limit; no OOM kill signal, so likely probe-timing regression from new image, not memory exhaustion. Pods self-recovered ~4min later per logs, but recurs each restart cycle (restart_count 12) til probe window widened. Safest fix: revert image to prior known-good 3.12-alpine.
proposal.expected_effect: checkout reverts to prior image; startup behavior returns to previously stable profile, liveness probes stop killing pods before boot completes, pods_ready returns to 2/2, restart_count stabilizes.

reasons: Passed all policies. Held for operator approval before execution.
